data.name: IdentityVerificationFailed
data.value: The Windows client could not verify the local runtime. Close other applications using its port, then reopen the client.

data.name: RecoveryDatabaseRunning
data.value: The local runtime or database is still running. Close other Techstack windows and reopen the client to finish recovery. Your recovery data has been preserved.

data.name: RecoverySnapshotMissing
data.value: The pre-update data backup is missing. Restore the client recovery data before reopening Techstack. Your current data has been preserved.

data.name: RecoveryRestoreFailed
data.value: The client could not restore its pre-update data. Close applications using the local data and reopen the client. Recovery remains pending.

data.name: RecoveryInstallationPending
data.value: The previous Techstack version has not been restored. Repair the Windows installation before reopening the client. Recovery data has been preserved.

data.name: WalletRevealPrompt
data.value: Reveal the credential for {0}? The value will be shown in this local Techstack window.

data.name: WalletRevealFailed
data.value: The local credential reveal could not be verified. Try again.
